steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Geological hazards arise from Earth processes that pose risk to people and property: landslides, subsidence, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, flooding

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Landslides (mass movement): rockfalls, slides, flows and creep; triggered by heavy rain, earthquakes, undercutting, or human activity

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Factors affecting slope stability: angle, geology (weak layers, joints), water content (lubricates and adds weight), vegetation (stabilises or destabilises)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Subsidence: ground sinking due to dissolution of limestone (sinkholes), mining, or groundwater extraction
